inputs.accepts: check; check --seed returns before this guard
existing FRONTMATTER boundary at file start; --- delimiters; read_text normalizes CRLF
inputs.limit: BOM, leading blank text and general YAML document forms are not parsed

inputs.accepts: top-level exact profile key; literal pilot, 'pilot' or double-quoted pilot; optional horizontal spaces and whitespace-separated trailing # comment
inputs.rejects: poc/prod; literal # inside the value; different case

inputs.accepts: top-level exact status key; literal ideation, 'ideation' or double-quoted ideation; optional horizontal spaces and whitespace-separated trailing # comment
inputs.rejects: other stages; literal # inside the value; different case

inputs.accepts: decision_ledger.gate_entries canonical SD-written stage: ideation under gates
inputs.limit: the existing reader does not unquote or strip comments from stage values

inputs.accepts: a resolution: mapping with no inline value, reached by the existing gates walker
inputs.limit: withdrawal is not an approval; commented resolution mapping or flow-style mapping is not recognized

inputs.accepts: approve, single-quoted approve or JSON double-quoted approve via decision_ledger.scalar/unquote
inputs.limit: a trailing comment on the decision value is not stripped

inputs.accepts: any recorded ideation approval exempts the task

boundary: The guard recognizes the listed scalar forms and canonical SD gate records; it is not a general YAML parser or an approval authenticator.
